input_roles: Version A ACS/PUMS payment and debt-service benchmarks
formula: Repeat each benchmark level in every month of its reference calendar year
benchmark_rule: Each populated monthly value and its 12-month arithmetic mean equal the matching Version A benchmark exactly
missing_value_policy: Preserve a benchmark null in all 12 months

input_roles: Version A annual HMDA rate or share
formula: Repeat the annual county rate or share in each activity-year month without division
benchmark_rule: Every populated monthly rate or share equals its Version A annual value
missing_value_policy: Preserve suppressed or low-sample annual nulls in all 12 months

input_roles: Version A annual HMDA flow plus unavailable financed purchase-dollar volume
formula: Emit explicit null canonical rows rather than substituting a proxy

input_roles: Version A annual HMDA flow plus Redfin monthly median sale price and homes sold
formula: Annual flow times each month median-price-times-sales divided by the annual sum; last eligible month absorbs the floating residual
benchmark_rule: Twelve monthly proxy values sum exactly to the Version A annual flow
missing_value_policy: Preserve null for suppressed annual flow or incomplete/nonpositive proxy weights

input_roles: Version A calibrated debt or equity anchor
formula: Emit explicit null rows because the universe-compatible calibration control is unavailable

input_roles: Version A raw debt anchor plus California NMDB all-mortgage growth and complete-set Redfin county homes-sold shares
formula: Scale the raw anchor by the NMDB UPB ratio and county sales-share ratio; NMDB is a growth indicator only
benchmark_rule: Every populated series equals its matching Version A raw anchor at the anchor month
missing_value_policy: Preserve null when the anchor NMDB value or complete county sales-share indicator is unavailable

input_roles: Version A PMMS debt sensitivity plus California NMDB all-mortgage growth and complete-set Redfin county sales shares
formula: Anchor times the NMDB UPB ratio times the county sales-share ratio; NMDB is a growth indicator only
benchmark_rule: Every populated scenario equals its matching Version A anchor at the anchor month
missing_value_policy: Preserve null when the anchor NMDB value or complete county sales-share indicator is unavailable

input_roles: Version A matched owner-value anchor plus Zillow county ZHVI plus matching PMMS debt sensitivity
formula: Update the owner-value stock by the ZHVI ratio and subtract matching scenario debt
benchmark_rule: Debt plus scenario equity equals the matched modeled owner-value stock
missing_value_policy: Preserve null when the value anchor HPI or matching debt is unavailable
